name: SaaS Dashboard
description: A refined, framework-free Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SaaS admin dashboard template: a dense metric hierarchy (MRR, customers, conversion, ARPU) with sparklines and deltas, an interactive revenue chart with two-series comparison and hover/touch tooltip, a plan-breakdown panel, an activity timeline, a transactions list, a sortable/paginated/filterable customers table that transforms to cards on mobile, and a workspace-usage panel. Restrained neutral design system with one indigo accent, light/dark mode, and a responsive sidebar that becomes an off-canvas drawer. All CSS/JS inlined in a single self-contained file.
features: Dense metric hierarchy: primary MRR + 3 secondary KPIs (customers, conversion, ARPU) each with delta + mini sparkline
Interactive SVG revenue chart: 7d/30d/12m period toggle, two-series (current vs last) comparison, axes, gridlines, and hover/touch tooltip with crosshair
Plan-breakdown panel with stacked-bar + legend (customers + MRR per plan) and total MRR
Activity timeline with avatars, event, target, status dot, and timestamp
Transactions list with invoice IDs, amounts, and status pills
Sortable, paginated, filterable customers table that transforms to stacked cards on mobile
Workspace-usage panel with quota bars and an upgrade prompt
Light/dark mode: follows prefers-color-scheme on first paint (no-flash) with a persisted header toggle
Refined neutral design system (--ds-* tokens): cool-stone surfaces, hairline borders, restrained shadows, one indigo accent, semantic status colors
Responsive sidebar that becomes an off-canvas drawer (Esc + backdrop to close) below 1024px
Data abstraction: all content lives in a single DASHBOARD object — swap in a real API without touching render code
Accessible: skip link, semantic landmarks, ARIA on interactive controls, focus-visible rings, reduced-motion safe, real button controls
Zero dependencies — open preview.html directly in a browser (only external request is Google Fonts)
accessibility: ARIA roles and labels on interactive controls
